description: Alongside: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: A tender is under way near the {base}. Fly alongside, match her speed within 400 metres and hold for ten seconds. Press T to target her, then Tab to match her speed.
success: Speed matched and held. That is how you park in motion.
failure: The tender has gone on without you. We will try again.
radio-tender: Pell: The tender ahead is moving. T to target her, then Tab matches your speed to hers. Fly close and keep the throttle steady.
Pell: Catch up with the tender, then press Tab. You take her speed. W and S nudge it if you drift.
